rationale: The stock gapped down ~19% and has auctioned below session VWAP ($13.24) and the 5m 9-EMA all morning; the early pop to $13.76 was fully sold and price sits in the bottom 15% of the day's range, with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.74%, VIXY +2.8%) favoring continued drift.
